meta.name: add-rtk
meta.description: Install rtk token-compression proxy into agent containers. Routes Bash tool calls through rtk for 60–90% token savings on dev commands (git, cargo, pytest, docker, kubectl, etc.).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在容器中安装 rtk 代理以压缩令牌，节省开发命令的令牌消耗
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果使用 AI 辅助开发且想减少令牌消耗
copy.tagline_en: Install rtk proxy in containers to compress tokens and save on dev commands
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use AI-assisted development and want to reduce token usage

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 每次 Bash 调用都会自动经 rtk 过滤,压缩 git、cargo、pytest 等开发命令的输出,原文称可省 60–90% token,且不需要在 CLAUDE.md 里写指令。
howto.when: 当你要给某个 agent group 安装 rtk(装二进制、挂载、写 PreToolUse hook、重启容器),或安装完成后 Claude 执行任意 Bash 命令时。

say.text: 给这个 agent group 装上 rtk
say.note: 会装二进制、加挂载、写 hook 并重启容器。

say.text: 确认容器里 rtk --version 能跑
say.note: 用 docker exec 检查挂载是否生效。

say.text: 看看 rtk 帮我省了多少 token
say.note: 运行 rtk gain 查看节省统计。

howto.what_en: Once installed, every Bash call Claude makes is routed through the rtk proxy, compressing output of dev commands like git, cargo and pytest. The skill states 60-90% token savings, with no CLAUDE.md instructions needed.
howto.when_en: When you want rtk installed into an agent group (binary, mount, PreToolUse hook, restart), or afterwards when Claude runs any Bash command.

say_en.text: Install rtk into this agent group
say_en.note: Installs, mounts, writes the hook, restarts the container.

say_en.text: Check that rtk --version runs inside the container
say_en.note: Runs docker exec to verify the mount.

say_en.text: Show how many tokens rtk saved
say_en.note: Runs rtk gain for savings stats.
